shared_elements: marks/figures carved or painted on a natural rock face
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic marks applied to an unshaped natural rock face, and A's eroded relief may include humanoid/sign elements, but the specific content differs sharply: B shows two elongated stick-like anthropomorphs standing side by side with linked arms and one holding an outstretched club-like object, while A shows a cluster of small rectilinear glyph-like signs and framed motifs with no clear standing figures or held implements. The only correspondence is the generic one of schematic markings on rock, which any tradition could produce independently.
